metadata.question: Were crops near the southern Iberian Peninsula healthier (indicated with NDVI) from March 25 to April 23, 2023 as compared to the longer-term average from 2000-2010?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare crop health (using NDVI) in southern Iberian Peninsula between: - 2023 (March 25 to April 23) - Long-term average (2000-2010 for the same date range) Strategy: 1. Use MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1) for long-term data availability (2000-present) 2. Define a region covering southern Iberian Peninsula 3. Calculate mean NDVI for both periods 4. Compare if 2023 NDVI > long-term average Data Quality Checks: - Check if collections have images - Check if valid pixels exist after processing - Validate NDVI values are reasonable (0-1 range) Potential issues: - MODIS data might have gaps - Need to handle cloud masking (MODIS has quality bands) - Need to ensure comparable seasonal periods ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-7.5, 36.0, -1.5, 38.5]); // Southern Iberian Peninsula // Date ranges const date2023 = ['2023-03-25', '2023-04-23']; const dateLongTerm = ['2000-03-25', '2010-04-23']; // 2. Data Acquisition - Use MODIS for long-term consistency const modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') .select('NDVI') .filterBounds(region); const ndvi2023 = modis.filterDate(date2023[0], date2023[1]); const ndviLongTerm = modis.filterDate(dateLongTerm[0], dateLongTerm[1]); // Check data availability const count2023 = ndvi2023.size().getInfo(); const countLongTerm = ndviLongTerm.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2023 Images: ${count2023}, Long-term Images: ${countLongTerm}`); if (count2023 === 0 || countLongTerm === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NDVI const mean2023 = ndvi2023.mean().multiply(0.0001); // MODIS scaling const meanLongTerm = ndviLongTerm.mean().multiply(0.0001); // Calculate pixel counts to detect C2 const countStats2023 = mean2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const countStatsLT = meanLongTerm.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels - 2023: ${countStats2023}, Long-term: ${countStatsLT}`); if (countStats2023 === 0 || countStatsLT === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean NDVI values const ndviVal2023 = mean2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const ndviValLongTerm = meanLongTerm.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`NDVI 2023: ${ndviVal2023?.toFixed(3)}, Long-term: ${ndviValLongTerm?.toFixed(3)}`); // Check for invalid values if (ndviVal2023 === null || ndviValLongTerm === null || isNaN(ndviVal2023) || isNaN(ndviValLongTerm) || ndviVal2023 < -1 || ndviVal2023 > 1 || ndviValLongTerm < -1 || ndviValLongTerm > 1) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare values - 2023 higher than long-term average means healthier if (ndviVal2023 > ndviValLongTerm) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
